problem.name: QUIESCENCE_COUNTER_SURFACE_COVERAGE_GAP
observed: The existing runtime quiescence probe compared only derived free swarm/LIVE_METRICS.json worker usage before/after the bounded window.
The current nearly co-temporal LIVE_METRICS snapshot reports openrouter/free requests=288 while SYSTEM_ANALYSIS_LIVE shared_provider_budget reports openrouter total_requests=4230.
tools/free_swarm_quota.py increments provider_state.total_requests inside acquire() before a provider request proceeds.
problem.inference: LIVE_METRICS worker usage and the shared provider-budget attempt counters are not identical evidence surfaces; derived worker-metric stability alone is insufficient for the declared zero provider-counter-delta closure condition.
problem.hypothesis: Direct read-only sampling of provider_budget.sqlite3 cumulative counters plus unexpired leases closes this measurement gap for provider attempts routed through the shared quota gate, while retaining LIVE_METRICS as an independent secondary surface.
problem.counterhypothesis: If every provider-capable request were fully represented in LIVE_METRICS with no lag or omitted lanes, direct shared-budget sampling would be redundant. The observed 288 vs 4230 OpenRouter request counts falsify identity/equivalence of the two surfaces at the current snapshot, though they do not by themselves prove which individual process caused each attempt.

behavior: add --provider-budget-db with CLAY_FREE_PROVIDER_BUDGET_DB/default shared SQLite path
read provider_state cumulative counters through SQLite mode=ro without lease cleanup or mutation
require direct shared-budget evidence for PASS_COMPONENT_ONLY
fail if shared-budget counter digest changes during the observation window
fail if an unexpired shared-budget lease exists at either boundary
retain derived LIVE_METRICS stability and forbidden-process sampling as independent gates

key_regressions: direct shared-budget counter change is detected even when derived LIVE_METRICS signature remains static
missing shared-budget DB evidence fails closed
existing forbidden-process and derived-usage-change rejections remain covered

negative_evidence.fault: file_sha256 accidentally called .hexdigest() on the already-hex string returned by _sha256_bytes during manual connector transfer

next_exact_action: On the owning live host, with current FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION HARD_OFF, execute tools/free_swarm_runtime_quiescence_enforcer_v1.py --apply so its bounded probe uses the direct shared provider-budget DB surface; require zero matching provider-capable process trees, zero unexpired shared-budget leases, stable direct shared-budget cumulative counters, stable derived LIVE_METRICS provider usage, and no provider probe before granting only runtime-quiescence component credit.
